name: Conquer The World WW2 [🛡️]
desc:
Lead your nation to world domination in this strategy war game! 🏆

[⚡] Similar to Hearts of Iron (Hoi4), but faster and more fun ‼

[⚔️] Historical Warfare: Lead your country through WW1, WW2, and WW3
[🏭] Industrial Power: Build a massive economy to fuel your war machine
[🦅] Empire Expansion: Use brilliant tactics to capture territories and expand borders
[😈] World Domination: Crush rivals and establish yourself as the ultimate superpower

Features
[🗡️] Military Strategy: Deep troop micromanagement and tactical combat
[🌍] Massive World: Over 200+ conquerable countries across a global map
[💣] Scenarios: Switch between eras including WW1, WW2, and WW3
[🏭] Nation Building: Complex economy management and industrial growth
[☢️] Nuclear Arsenal: Develop and deploy devastating weapons of mass destruction

Updates
[👑] Formables !

Upcoming Updates
[🧪] Map Editor

scripts.title: Basic working script
scripts.features:
Features

Smart Production

Manages consumer goods and military production automatically
Adjusts factory allocation based on war status, stockpiles, and troop needs
Supports custom stockpile goals, production locks, and war preparation modes
Handles uranium, U-235, and nuclear production dependencies

Automatic Factory Construction

Chooses cities using configurable priorities
Uses accurate pricing and queue limits
Can pause during negative profit
Respects protected resource reserves

Smart Research

Fills empty technology slots automatically
Supports multiple research paths (Industry, Army, Airforce, Navy, Missile, Balanced)
Checks prerequisites before purchasing tech
Can select useful government focuses without changing ideology

Central Spending Manager

Coordinates research and factory spending in one system
Protects money, manpower, and political power
Supports reserves, spending limits, and priorities
Revalidates resources before every purchase

Smart Missile Support

Assists in battles and capital defense
Supports camera-based, manual, and auto-targeting
Targets silos, fleets, and invasion threats
Checks range, ammo, cooldowns, and airspace safety
Learns from past strikes to avoid waste
Uses only conventional missiles (no automatic nukes)

Unified Capital Defense

Maintains capital garrison and emergency reinforcements
Coordinates production, missiles, and naval transport
Prevents unsafe naval boarding during threats

Naval Transportation

Loads and manages transport ships automatically
Supports preferred ports and skips unsafe ones
Can spawn replacement troops
Does not auto-create fleets or move ships after departure

Live Dashboard & Settings

Shows automation activity and spending decisions
Includes notifications, refresh tools, and recovery options
Saves settings between servers (if supported)
